description: Verify email addresses one at a time or in bulk batches with Emailable, and read the account's credits.

api.description: Get the credits left on the account. The owner email is not stored.
Start verifying a list of up to 50,000 addresses. Uses one credit per address. Poll batches.get for the results.

fields.description: HTTPS URL Emailable POSTs the results to when the batch finishes.

fields.type: (accept_all | birth_year | did_you_mean | disposable | domain | email | first_name | free | full_name | gender | last_name | mailbox_full | mx_record | no_reply | reason | role | score | smtp_provider | state | tag | user)[]
fields.description: Only return these fields per address.
Retry unclear mail-server answers (default true). Off is faster.

api.description: Get a batch: progress, counts per state and reason, and each address's result (up to 1,000 addresses) or a download link (larger batches).

fields.description: Return results verified so far (batches of up to 1,000 only).

fields.type: { id: string, message?: string, processed?: number, total?: number, done: boolean, emails?: { email?: string, state?: string | null, reason?: string | null, score?: number | null, domain?: string | null, user?: string | null, tag?: string | null, did_you_mean?: string | null, accept_all?: boolean | null, disposable?: boolean | null, free?: boolean | null, role?: boolean | null, no_reply?: boolean | null, mailbox_full?: boolean | null, smtp_provider?: string | null, mx_record?: string | null, duration?: number | null }[], downloadFile?: string, totalCounts?: Record<string, number>, reasonCounts?: Record<string, number> }

api.description: Verify one email address: state (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown), reason, score, and flags such as disposable, free, role and accept-all, plus a did-you-mean suggestion. Uses one credit. If `pending` is true, call again within 5 minutes at no extra cost.

fields.description: Run the SMTP check (default true). Off is faster but less accurate.
Also run the accept-all check (default false). Slower.
Seconds to wait for a result (2-10, default 5).

fields.type: { email: string, state?: string | null, reason?: string | null, score?: number | null, domain?: string | null, user?: string | null, tag?: string | null, did_you_mean?: string | null, accept_all?: boolean | null, disposable?: boolean | null, free?: boolean | null, role?: boolean | null, no_reply?: boolean | null, mailbox_full?: boolean | null, smtp_provider?: string | null, mx_record?: string | null, duration?: number | null }

fields.description: True when Emailable is still verifying (HTTP 249). Call again within 5 minutes; repeats in that window are free.
